Author: dongkyeomjang <jangelliot0404@dgu.ac.kr>
Date:   Sat Oct 17 13:41:46 2026 +0900

    회원 정지 및 해제 기능 추가
    
    정지된 회원은 대출을 요청할 수 없으며 POST /loans 는 409 MEMBER_SUSPENDED 를 반환한다.
    POST /members/{memberId}/suspend 와 POST /members/{memberId}/unsuspend 로 상태를 바꾸며
    두 API 는 변경된 회원을 200 으로 반환하고, 없는 회원이면 404 를 반환한다.
    GET /members/{memberId} 와 회원 등록 응답에는 suspended 필드가 포함되며 새 회원은 false 다.
    정지 여부는 member 테이블의 suspended 컬럼에 저장한다.
    
    Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

    java
    id("org.springframework.boot") version "3.5.3"
}

group = "com.example"

java {
    toolchain {
        languageVersion = JavaLanguageVersion.of(21)
    }
}

repositories {
    mavenCentral()
}

dependencies {
    implementation(platform(SpringBootPlugin.BOM_COORDINATES))
    implementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-web")
    implementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-data-jpa")
    runtimeOnly("com.h2database:h2")
    testImplementation("org.springframework.boot:spring-boot-starter-test")
    testRuntimeOnly("org.junit.platform:junit-platform-launcher")
}

tasks.withType<JavaCompile>().configureEach {
    options.compilerArgs.add("-parameters")
}

tasks.test {
    useJUnitPlatform()
}

apply(from = "gradle/arch.gradle.kts")

content.text:
`GET /stats/monthly?year=&month=` is in place and returns the four counts and the late-fee total you specified. The build passes, the 4 new integration tests pass, and the 7 architecture tests pass. I committed the change to `feat/loan-limit` as `f9c2fd8`.

- **Counting rules:** `loanCount` counts loans whose `loanedAt` falls in the month. `returnCount`, `overdueCount` and `lateFeeTotal` count loans whose `returnedAt` falls in the month. An overdue return is one with a late fee above 0. A month with no activity returns all zeros.
- **Bad input:** a month outside 1–12 returns `400`. A year outside `Year.MIN_VALUE`–`Year.MAX_VALUE` also returns `400`.
- **Structure:** this follows the hexagonal layout in CLAUDE.md. It adds a use case and a service, two new load methods on `LoadLoanPort`, the matching JPA queries, and a `StatsController` that returns a `MonthlyStatsResponse` record.
- **Tests:** `MonthlyStatsIntegrationTest` covers a loan in one month returned late in the next, an on-time return, an empty month, and an out-of-range month. Each test uses its own month in 2031 so the shared H2 database can't mix in data from other tests.

The service loads every matching loan into memory and counts them in Java. That's simple and fine at library scale, but it would need count queries if monthly volume grows a lot.
